content_voiceover: This is part two of the ICC classification of MDS, laying out the non T P 53 categories using dysplasia, blast percentage, cytogenetics, and mutations. MDS with mutated S F 3 B 1 requires at least one dysplastic lineage, blasts under 5 percent marrow and under 2 percent blood, cytogenetics that exclude isolated 5 q deletion, monosomy 7 or 7 q deletion, abnormality of 3 q 26.2, or complex karyotype, and an S F 3 B 1 mutation with variant allele frequency at least 10 percent, without multi hit T P 53 or R U N X 1 mutation. MDS with del 5 q requires the same low blast range, a 5 q deletion with at most one additional abnormality other than minus 7 or 7 q deletion, and any mutation except multi hit T P 53. MDS not otherwise specified is subdivided by dysplasia count. Zero lineages of dysplasia, combined with minus 7, 7 q deletion, or complex karyotype, and no multi hit T P 53 or high S F 3 B 1, gives MDS N O S without dysplasia. One lineage of dysplasia gives MDS N O S with single lineage dysplasia, and two or more lineages gives MDS N O S with multilineage dysplasia, both excluding multi hit T P 53 and criteria for the del 5 q or S F 3 B 1 categories. MDS with excess blasts, or MDS dash E B, requires 5 to 9 percent marrow blasts or 2 to 9 percent blood blasts, any cytogenetics, and any mutation except multi hit T P 53. Finally MDS slash AML spans 10 to 19 percent blasts, any cytogenetics except AML defining ones, and any mutation except N P M 1, basic leucine zipper C E B P A, or T P 53.
keypoints: S F 3 B 1 and del 5 q categories each need at least one dysplastic lineage and low blasts
MDS N O S is subdivided by dysplasia count: zero, one, or two or more lineages
MDS dash E B covers 5 to 9 percent marrow or 2 to 9 percent blood blasts
MDS slash AML covers 10 to 19 percent blasts and excludes AML defining mutations
Multi hit T P 53 is excluded from essentially every non T P 53 ICC category
keypoint_voiceover: Notice the pattern across this whole ICC table. Multi hit T P 53 is carved out of every other category, because once it is present the case falls into the T P 53 mutated pathway from the previous slide instead. Also remember that MDS N O S is purely dysplasia driven, zero lineages means without dysplasia, one lineage means single lineage, and two or more means multilineage.
